content_sections.heading: GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Goa Samagra Shiksha has announced a total of 78 vacancies for the Teacher (Foundational Stage) post. The vacancies are distributed across different blocks of Goa. Category-wise vacancy details include OBC - 21 posts, ST - 9 posts, SC - 2 posts and UR - 46 posts.

content_sections.heading: GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational and experience requirements mentioned in the recruitment notification. The essential qualification requirements are: HSSC or equivalent certificate from a recognized board. Diploma in Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) or Pre-Primary Teacher Education (PPTT) / D.El.Ed. OR B.Ed. in Early Childhood Education as per NEP-2020. OR Diploma in Special Education with valid RCI registration for inclusive classrooms. One year teaching or apprenticeship experience. Knowledge of Konkani. Four-year integrated B.Ed. (Foundational Stage) as per NCTE’s new framework. Master’s degree in Child Development, Psychology or Education. The age limit for GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026 is as per Government norms.

content_sections.heading: GSS Teacher Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Teacher (Foundational Stage) post will receive a fixed consolidated monthly salary of ₹20,000. The appointment will be purely on a contract basis up to 31 March 2027.

content_sections.heading: GSS Teacher Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for GSS Teacher Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through a Walk-in Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria can attend the walk-in interview along with the required documents. Prepare an application along with full biodata. Carry original and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents. Required documents include birth certificate, educational qualification certificates, valid residential certificate, employment exchange registration and other relevant certificates. Report before the commencement of the interview.

content_sections.heading: GSS Teacher Walk-in Interview Details
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM on the scheduled date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GSS Teacher (Foundational Stage) Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Goa Samagra Shiksha for the post of Teacher (Foundational Stage) through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GSS Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 78 Teacher (Foundational Stage) vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GSS Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have HSSC or equivalent qualification along with ECCE/PPTT/D.El.Ed, B.Ed in Early Childhood Education, or Diploma in Special Education with valid RCI registration as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GSS Teacher?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive ₹20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for GSS Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GSS Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by attending the walk-in interview with the required application, biodata and documents.
